title: Pipe Repair Project in Valencia Park!
description:
Infrastructure improvements in Valencia Park! 👏 Over the past few weeks, City employees have been installing new pipes and drain structures to improve the neighborhood's stormwater infrastructure.  These improvements will help prevent flooding during the rainy season.

Our City employees work year-round to repair and maintain the City's infrastructure. Learn more about San Diego's vast stormwater system at ThinkBlue.org

#SanDiegoAtWork
